snippet.title: The No Jumpscare Show TEASER
snippet.description:
Introducing: The No Jumpscare Show! 🎭
👇 Wishlist on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4889280/The_No_Jumpscare_Show/

If you want to support me, my projects, or just leave a tip, you can right here:
☕ Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/polypaw
🍕 BuyMeACoffee: https://buymeacoffee.com/polypaw (Try this one if Ko-fi doesn't work for you!)

As I mentioned before, this is a bite-sized project I've been building to avoid burnout and help with the rest of FERALPALS 2 (which is still cooking, don't worry! :D).

Thanks so much for the constant support!!

#TheNoJumpscareShow #IndieGame #HorrorGaming #PSXHorror #ComedyHorror #mascothorror #GameDev #Polypaw
